branding.strategy: Separate provider SVG layer; replace logo file and provider registry entry; no master re-generation.
branding.visibility: Hidden during idle and silhouette morph; visible after event form settles.
branding.frame_metadata: Each future frame records logo centre, rectangle, rotation, opacity and occlusion mask if needed. Current coordinates apply to these static masters only.
branding.compact_policy: Below 48 logical pixels prefer external provider badge + text rather than force the internal logo.

planned_clips.description: Float, blink, tilt; occasional tiny squash or peek. No permanent core.
Tuck hands in, round scallops, soft squish, settle into orb. Logo opacity stays 0.
Small pleased bounce and settle. Logo fades in below the face over first 8 frames.
Tuck limbs, gently inflate corners, tiny overshoot, settle. Logo stays hidden.
Curious alternating tilt and gaze at user. Separate external question indicator.
Tuck arms and scallops into a broad round base; raise three upward flame tongues. Preserve face identity and hide the logo during the morph.
Gently sway the upward flame tongues and rounded body, attentive eyes; no lower curling tail.
Fade logo out, undo shape, reveal little arms and scallops.

notes: Planned frames have not been generated. SVG examples are layered static compositions.
For native integration preserve original finished/question events; current state mapper may collapse some into idle/approval.
For company branding use a clear square transparent SVG/PNG; apply contain, never stretch.
Actual melt/morph motion requires generated in-between frames, not CSS shape interpolation.
